title: Paulina Bradley named Big 12 Reining Rider of the Month for September
text:

Sports
Paulina Bradley named Big 12 Reining Rider of the Month for September
Baylor freshman Paulina Bradley was named Big 12 Reining Rider of the Month for September following strong performances early in the season. Bradley remains undefeated as Baylor Equestrian posts a winning record.
Baylor equestrian freshman Paulina Bradley has been named Big 12 Reining Rider of the Month for September, according to an Oct. 8 announcement by the conference office.
Bradley earned this recognition after securing her first collegiate career win in Baylor's season opener against South Dakota State. The Windsor, Colorado, native defeated her opponent with a score of 72.25-70.25 and received her first career Most Outstanding Performer honor.
The Baylor equestrian team holds a 2-1 record on the season after sweeping both Delaware State, 12-8, and No. 10 UT Martin, 9-6, in a doubleheader held last Friday, Oct. 2. Bradley is currently undefeated at 2-0 on the season with an average score of 71.85.
The team continues its season as it looks to build on early successes from both new and returning athletes.
